outcome: Affective psychoses (including bipolar disorder and depression with psychosis)
cohort: All singleton live births in Sweden between 1982 and 1995 (n= 1,345,210)
finding: While elective cesarean section was initially associated with an increased risk of psychosis in offspring, this association disappeared after adjusting for familial factors in a sibling-matched analysis.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was initially associated with an increased risk of psychosis in offspring, but this association disappeared after sibling-matching.
